scenes.dialogue: Every civil case in India begins with one question. Not 'Who is right?' Not 'How much can I claim?'
scenes.spoken: Every civil case in India begins with one question. Not 'Who is right?' Not 'How much can I claim?'

scenes.dialogue: The first question is: do you have a cause of action? Get this wrong, and your suit can be thrown out before the defendant even files a written statement.
